selection_rule: Highest validation JSON exact, then fewer examples, then lower p95; failures count as incorrect.

configuration.model_source: Docker runtime environment recorded in deployment
configuration.latency_scope: client-observed POST /parse over HTTP, 8 concurrent clients; excludes client queue wait

deployment.transport: HTTP POST /parse to Docker published localhost port

assumptions: Standard processing, text tokens, no more than 272000 input tokens per request.

Cache writes with no retention breakdown use the 30-minute write rate.

cost.projection_assumption: Same query mix, routing, cache behavior, token usage, and prices as this run.
